preconditions.description: The number of fields, n, is an integer between 1 and 60000 inclusive.
The number of die faces, m, is an integer between 4 and 100000 inclusive.
The number of turns, k, is an integer between 1 and 1000 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: len(stdin.splitlines()) >= 3 and len(stdin.splitlines()[1].split()) == n and len(stdin.splitlines()[2].split()) == m
preconditions.description: The input contains exactly three lines: the first line with n, m, k; the second line with n integers (f_i); and the third line with m integers (p_j).

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= int(f) <= n for f in stdin.splitlines()[1].split())
preconditions.description: Each field i has a transition value f_i that is an integer between 1 and n inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(0 <= int(p) < 998244353 for p in stdin.splitlines()[2].split())
preconditions.description: Each die face probability p_j is an integer between 0 and 998244352 inclusive.
The sum of all die face probabilities modulo 998244353 equals 1.

postconditions.description: The output contains exactly n lines, one for each field.

postconditions.expression: all(0 <= int(line) < 998244353 for line in stdout.splitlines())
postconditions.description: Each output line is an integer between 0 and 998244352 inclusive, representing the probability modulo 998244353.

postconditions.expression: all(0 <= int(stdout.splitlines()[i-1]) < 998244353 for i in range(1, n+1)) and sum(int(stdout.splitlines()[i-1]) for i in range(1, n+1)) % 998244353 == 1
postconditions.description: The sum of all output probabilities modulo 998244353 equals 1, representing a valid probability distribution.

postconditions.expression: all(int(stdout.splitlines()[i-1]) == (sum((1/n) * (sum(int(p) for p in stdin.splitlines()[2].split() if int(d) == j) / sum(int(p) for p in stdin.splitlines()[2].split())) for j in range(m)) for _ in range(k)) for i in range(1, n+1)) % 998244353)
postconditions.description: The output probability for each field i is computed by simulating k turns of the game, starting from each field with equal probability (1/n), and summing the probabilities of ending at field i after k turns, all modulo 998244353.
